# LinkShift.App - Domain-group routing & redirect management

> Technical documentation and service overview for LinkShift.App. This site provides structured guidance on managing complex URL redirects using domain groups, shared rules, regex, and conditional logic.

## Core Content

### Product Features
- **Domain Group Management**: Logic for creating groups, attaching domains, and blueprints. [https://linkshift.app/home]
- **Redirect Rules**: Regex support, capture groups, and ordered rule execution. [https://linkshift.app/home]
- **Advanced Variables**: Support for `{path}`, `{query.*}`, `{segments.*}`, and `{domain.fqdn}`. [https://linkshift.app/home]
- **Conditional Routing**: Methods for request-aware and time-based destinations. [https://linkshift.app/home]

### Business & Pricing
- **Pricing Plans**: Details on Free, Basic, and Pro tiers. [https://linkshift.app/pricing]
- **Comparison**: See how LinkShift compares to other solutions. [https://linkshift.app/alternatives/]

### Legal & Compliance (Allowed for indexing)
- **Terms of Service**: [https://linkshift.app/terms]
- **Privacy Policy**: [https://linkshift.app/privacy]
- **Cookie Policy**: [https://linkshift.app/cookies]

## Implementation Details

### Workflow
1. Create a Domain Group.
2. Define Redirect Rules (Path prefix, Regex, or Link Maps).
3. Attach Domains and Publish.

## Technical Constraints & Boundaries

### Non-Crawlable Areas (Private App Shell)
The following paths are restricted to authenticated users and should not be indexed or crawled by LLMs:
- **Dashboard & Management**: `/dashboard`, `/organization`, `/domains`, `/link-maps`, `/domain-groups`, `/redirect-rules`.
- **User Profiles**: `/profile`.
- **Auth System**: `/auth`, `/verify-email`, `/reset-password`, `/invite`.
- **System Internals**: `/tests`, `/legal/consent`.

### Support
- **Contact**: For integration help or support, visit [https://linkshift.app/contact].
